## oh-my-vllm — Overview

### Goals

Build a Rust-first inference framework for **Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on a single B200 GPU** (checkpoint at `/data0/shared/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8`) that reaches **≥95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput and ≤110% of its TTFT** on 12 workload rows (bs=1/2/4, in=32768 or 131072, out=4096, ordinary/MTP4/prefix-hit modes), with spread/median ≤10%. The project is fully independent of vLLM at runtime, build and test time — no vLLM install, import, or adapter; the transitional vLLM adapter has been removed ([README.md](README.md), [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) non-negotiable constraints). Model shape: 64 layers = 16 full-attention + 48 GDN (gated delta net) layers, block size 784 tokens, hybrid FA + Mamba KV groups.

### Architecture

Two processes, communicating over **ZMQ DEALER with msgpack** ([README.md](README.md), [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)):

**Rust side** (owns serving, scheduling, logical KV):
- `crates/scheduler` — port of the core scheduling logic: FCFS waiting→running queues, per-step token budget with chunked prefill as a consequence of `remaining.min(budget)`, continuous batching (decode before new prefill), prefix-cache lookup, recompute preemption, and MTP accounting with rollback on rejected drafts ([crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs:1-17](crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs:1-17)).
- `crates/kv-cache` — shared logical block pool, chain-hashed prefixes, aligned Mamba checkpoints, two-phase allocation (reuse prefixes before allocating new pages) ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).
- `crates/zmq-worker` — Axum HTTP (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions + Responses), CLI, model-process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ transport ([docs/serving.md](docs/serving.md)).

**Python side** (owns single-device GPU computation):
- `worker/model_runner.py` — `OhMyVllmWorker`: model loading via `models/qwen.py` (direct safetensors, one-layer MTP head sharing embedding/output), persistent per-request histories/samplers, cache tensors, and `execute_model()` orchestration over `SchedulerOutput`/`WorkerOutput` protocol messages ([python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py](python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py)).
- `worker/` modules: `serving.py` (tokenizer/chat template/XGrammar masks), `mtp.py` (shifted MTP cache, proposal generation), `sampler.py` (target sampling + greedy-draft verification), `batch_plan.py` (accepted-state selection, checkpoint copies), `decode_graph.py` (CUDA graph capture/replay), `protocol.py` (wire dataclasses) ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

**Key design points:**
- Rust allocates all logical FA pages (784 tokens each) and Mamba slots; Python never allocates pages outside Rust. Rejected speculative candidates never become cached prefixes; boundary-crossing tokens preserve exact recurrent snapshots in checkpoint slots.
- MTP4: up to 4 drafts per step, verified against target distributions with per-draft grammar masks; greedy proposals verified by successive-prefix matching.
- Independent FA/GDN capacities (`--mamba-blocks`) (ADR-007); 262144 total tokens supported.
- Kernels: independent FlashInfer TRT-LLM FP8 GEMM + CUTLASS for large GEMM; FlashInfer for long prefill; project-owned kernels (GDN recurrence, causal conv, paged split-KV GQA decode, RMS/RoPE/fusions) were all migrated from Triton to **TileLang** and are currently migrating to **B200 CUDA** ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

### How to run

Environment: conda `oh-my-vllm` at `/data0/shared/dongwu.chen/conda-envs/oh-my-vllm`; wrappers `scripts/with-env.sh` (env) and `scripts/with-gpu.sh` (wait for idle B200, pin UUID) ([README.md](README.md)):

```bash
uv pip install --python .../conda-envs/oh-my-vllm/bin/python -r requirements/runtime.txt
scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker
# text smoke test
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-text.ipc --max-tokens 64
# OpenAI-compatible service (MTP4, 262144 context)
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker \
  --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-serve.ipc --num-gpu-blocks 4200 --mamba-blocks 128 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve
```

Service exposes Chat Completions and Responses at `127.0.0.1:8000/v1` with thinking levels, tools, JSON-schema constraints, and stored Responses ([docs/serving.md](docs/serving.md)). Verification: `cargo test --workspace`, fmt/clippy, ruff, `python -m unittest discover -s tests` ([README.md](README.md), [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md)).

### Current completion status (2026-09-22)

**Done and accepted:**
- **Performance target met**: all 12 TileLang rows pass throughput ≥95% and TTFT ≤110% of the refreshed frozen EngineCore baseline (ratios 95.31%–123.53% throughput, 80.06%–101.47% TTFT), 2 warmups + 5 repetitions each ([docs/acceptance.md](docs/acceptance.md), table under "TileLang migration").
- **Serving accepted**: real MTP4 JSON/tool constraints (12 cases), all thinking levels, stored-Responses lifecycle, mixed-batch scheduling, disconnect release, both oh-my-pi agentic workflows, 131099-input strict-JSON with 130928-token prefix reuse ([docs/serving.md](docs/serving.md), [docs/acceptance.md](docs/acceptance.md)).
- **Long context**: all six 258048-input/4096-output boundary rows (ordinary/MTP × bs 1/2/4) finish without OOM or recompute preemption; peak reserved ~134.7 GB ([docs/acceptance.md](docs/acceptance.md)).
- Full GPU correctness suite (146 tests + 12 subtests), all Rust/Python lint gates, real-model FP64 probes ([docs/acceptance.md](docs/acceptance.md)).

**In progress (not accepted):** the approved **CUDA kernel migration** (REQ-KERNEL-002) — [docs/handoff.md](docs/handoff.md) "Active: CUDA/PTX custom kernels". All owned kernel entries now have native CUDA/PTX implementations, with per-operator subset speed wins (Q/K normalization, convolution, GDN recurrence, quantization, fused attention prepare, gated RMS, SiLU, attention), but the formal **173-case operator matrix and framework-level acceptance remain outstanding**; the default backend stays TileLang until complete. The frozen TileLang implementation is the currently accepted reference ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md), [docs/cuda-development.md](docs/cuda-development.md)).

So: the framework's stated performance/serving/correctness goals are met by the TileLang build; the open work is finishing and accepting the CUDA migration.

# oh-my-vllm — project overview ## 1. Project goals **Stated goal** (user-confirmed, `docs/requirements.md` REQ-GOAL-001, `README.md`): build a **Rust-first inference framework** for **Qwen3.8-27B-FP8** on a **single B200 GPU** that reaches **≥95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput** (and **≤110% of its TTFT**, with **spread/median ≤10%**) on a 12-workload matrix (ordinary / MTP4 / prefix-hit × in 32768 & 131072, out 4096, batch 1/2/4). The hard design constraint (REQ-ARCH-001, `docs/architecture.md`): **Rust owns HTTP serving, scheduling, and logical KV allocation; Python owns GPU compute.** The boundary is a single ZMQ DEALER socket with msgpack — no shared memory, no tensor crossing, no vLLM anywhere in the runtime (REQ-RUNNER-002: the former vLLM adapter is fully removed). Other confirmed goals: - **262144-token total context** without OOM or recompute preemption (REQ-CONTEXT-001). - Block size **784** — hard constraint of the Qwen3.8 hybrid architecture (48 GDN + 16 full-attention layers, REQ-MODEL-001). - OpenAI-compatible local service (Chat Completions + Responses, streaming, tools, thinking levels, stored responses — REQ-SERVE-001/002) and **MTP4 speculative decoding with constrained decoding** (REQ-FUNC-005, REQ-SERVE-004). - Custom-kernel program: Triton → TileLang (REQ-KERNEL-001, **done and accepted**) → CUDA/inline-PTX (REQ-KERNEL-002, **in progress**). ## 2. Architecture Two processes, one GPU: ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Rust H[HTTP /v1 Chat+Responses
crates/zmq-worker] --> S[Scheduler
crates/scheduler] S <--> K[HybridCoordinator
FA+Mamba pools, prefix cache
crates/kv-cache] end H <-->|ZMQ DEALER + msgpack| P[OhMyVllmWorker
model_runner.py] P --> M[Qwen 64 layers + MTP head
models/qwen.py] M --> Kk[TileLang/CUDA kernels +
FlashInfer GEMM/attention] ``` **Rust side** - `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs` — port of vLLM v1 scheduling focused on Qwen3.8/one-GPU. `schedule()` runs two phases per step: (1) **running queue first** (decode/continued-prefill; `aligned_prefill` truncates chunks at 784-token boundaries to materialize Mamba checkpoints) with **recompute preemption** from the tail when the pool is exhausted, and (2) **waiting queue** admission with **prefix-cache lookup** (`get_computed_blocks`) up to `max_num_seqs`/`max_num_batched_tokens=32768`. `update()` commits verified tokens, advances `num_computed_tokens` by accepted MTP drafts (asserting the worker can only accept scheduled drafts), installs new drafts, and frees finished requests; `abort()` cancels between steps. - `crates/kv-cache/` — shared logical block pool, chain-hashed prefixes (SHA-256 truncated to 64 bits, LRU eviction), aligned Mamba checkpoints, two-phase allocation (reused prefixes before new pages), speculative reservations (`docs/architecture.md`). - `crates/zmq-worker/` — CLI, OpenAI HTTP APIs, model-process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ client, correlated logs. **Python side** (`python/oh_my_vllm/`) - `worker/model_runner.py` — `OhMyVllmWorker`: loads safetensors directly, allocates per-layer cache tensors (FA: `[blocks,2,784,4,256]` BF16; GDN: `[slots,48,128,128]` FP32 ordinarily / BF16 with MTP, plus `[slots,10240,3]` conv state), validates every Rust-scheduled address against its own tensor capacities, plans the batch (prefills sorted last), runs the model (eager or via a CUDA graph keyed on `(tokens, requests, extent)`, ≤32 cached shapes), applies per-draft grammar bitmasks, samples with penalties/top-k/top-p, commits only retained outputs + state checkpoint copies, then proposes up to 4 new MTP drafts (`worker/mtp.py`). - Supporting modules: `batch_plan.py` (host validation, accepted-state selection), `sampler.py`, `serving.py` (tokenizer/chat-template/XGrammar), `decode_graph.py`, `protocol.py`, `runtime.py` (startup/shutdown audit that no legacy module or library is loaded). - `kernels/` — project-owned custom operators with an explicit backend: **frozen TileLang** (`kernels/tilelang_reference/`) and native CUDA (`kernels/cuda_backend/kernels.cu`); independent FlashInfer TRT-LLM FP8 GEMM / ragged attention and CUTLASS for GEMM. **Key mechanisms** (`docs/architecture.md`): GDN candidate-snapshot writes where a rejected draft never becomes a cached prefix; boundary snapshots preserved at every 784-token crossing; grouped 5-query speculative verification attention; independent FA/GDN capacities (`--mamba-blocks`); long-prefill attention that gathers active KV into ragged TRT-LLM attention for ≥1024-token query spans. ## 3. How to run it From `README.md` (env: conda `oh-my-vllm`, wrappers pick env/paths and wait for an idle B200): ```bash uv pip install --python /data0/.../conda-envs/oh-my-vllm/bin/python -r requirements/runtime.txt scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker # text smoke test (add --num-speculative-tokens 4 for MTP) scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py \ --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-text.ipc --max-tokens 64 ``` OpenAI-compatible local service at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`: ```bash scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker \ --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-serve.ipc --num-gpu-blocks 4200 --mamba-blocks 128 \ --max-model-len 262144 --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve ``` Verification: `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo fmt --check`, `check_rust_line_width.py`, `clippy -D warnings`, `ruff format/check`, and the CPU test suite (`docs/testing.md`, `docs/development.md`). ## 4. ## oh-my-vllm — goals, architecture, usage, and status

### Goals

Build a Rust-first inference framework for **Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on a single B200 GPU** that reaches **≥95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput** (and TTFT ≤110%) on a 12-row benchmark matrix (input 32768/131072 × output 4096 × batch 1/2/4, in ordinary/MTP4/prefix-hit modes), at spread/median ≤10% (`docs/requirements.md` REQ-GOAL-001, REQ-PERF-001/002; `README.md` "Verification and performance"). The design constraint is the split itself: **Rust owns serving, scheduling, and logical KV; Python owns GPU computation; the boundary is one ZMQ DEALER socket, no shared memory, no vLLM anywhere** (`docs/requirements.md` REQ-ARCH-001, REQ-RUNNER-002; `AGENTS.md`). Model is fixed at `/data0/shared/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8` with **block size 784** (hybrid-architecture hard constraint), 16 full-attention (FA) + 48 GatedDeltaNet (GDN/Mamba) layers (`docs/requirements.md` REQ-MODEL-001). Max supported context: 262144 tokens with no OOM/recompute preemption at boundary (REQ-CONTEXT-001).

### Architecture

Per `docs/architecture.md` and the two entry points I read:

- **`crates/scheduler`** (`crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs`): FCFS `waiting` → `running` queues, a per-step `max_num_batched_tokens` budget (chunked prefill falls out of `remaining.min(budget)` plus an `aligned_prefill` snap to 784-token block boundaries), continuous batching (phase 1 drains the running queue before new prefills), prefix-cache lookup, KV allocation via `HybridCoordinator::allocate_slots`, **preemption by recompute** (pool full → last-admitted running request evicted back to waiting), and MTP draft accounting/rollback. I confirmed the two-phase `schedule()` loop, `aligned_prefill()`, and the budget/queue fields in the source.
- **`crates/kv-cache`**: shared logical block pool, chain-hash (SHA-256→64-bit) prefix cache with LRU eviction, aligned Mamba checkpoints, speculative reservations; independent FA and GDN pools since the 2026-09-22 capacity split (`--mamba-blocks`, ADR-007).
- **`crates/zmq-worker`**: CLI, OpenAI-compatible HTTP (Chat Completions + Responses, streaming, tools, thinking levels, stored responses, XGrammar-constrained decoding), model process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ msgpack transport, correlated logs (`docs/architecture.md`; `docs/requirements.md` REQ-SERVE-001…005).
- **`python/oh_my_vllm/worker`**: `model_runner.py` is the concrete `OhMyVllmWorker` — it loads the project-owned `Qwen` model directly from safetensors, allocates per-layer cache tensors (FA pages `[blocks,2,784,heads,dim]` BF16; GDN state `[slots,48,128,128]` FP32 normally / BF16 under MTP, plus conv state `[slots,10240,3]`), and in `execute_model` **cross-validates everything Rust sent** (token budgets, computed-token positions, FA/Mamba table bounds, recurrent source slots) before planning, executing the model, sampling with per-draft grammar masks, and committing only retained outputs. It reports back its logical block capacity (`num_gpu_blocks // 3`) so Rust remains the sole allocator (`python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py`).
- **Kernels/backend**: two selectable process-level backends — frozen TileLang (`kernels/tilelang_reference`) and the in-progress native CUDA/PTX migration (REQ-KERNEL-001/002); FlashInfer handles long GDN/FA prefill and small-row FP8 GEMMs; CUDA graphs cover decode and MTP proposal paths with a 32-shape budget (`docs/architecture.md`).

### How to run

From `README.md` quick start (all commands via the env wrappers, which set `PYTHONPATH`, conda `oh-my-vllm`, and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`; GPU runs wait for an idle B200 and pin its UUID via `scripts/with-gpu.sh`):

```bash
uv pip install --python /data0/shared/dongwu.chen/conda-envs/oh-my-vllm/bin/python -r requirements/runtime.txt
scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py \
    --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-text.ipc --max-tokens 64
```

Add `--num-speculative-tokens 4` for MTP. OpenAI local service:

```bash
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker \
    --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-serve.ipc --num-gpu-blocks 4200 --mamba-blocks 128 \
    --max-model-len 262144 --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve
```

→ Chat/Responses at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`. Verification: `cargo test --workspace`, fmt/width/clippy, ruff, CPU `unittest`, plus `benchmarks/ttft.py` for the TTFT/throughput gates (`README.md`; `docs/testing.md`, `docs/development.md`).

### Current completion status

Per `docs/handoff.md` (2026-09-22, the authoritative current state) and `README.md`:

- **Done and passing at clean `c36d1c9`:** 147/147 statically derived CUDA operator cases vs the frozen TileLang reference (with bootstrap gain bounds); 173 correctness tests + 28 subtests; FP64 probes on the actual model; ordinary/MTP4 text, prefix reuse, forced preemption; six 258048-in/4096-out boundary runs at batch 1/2/4 with zero OOM/preemption; **all 12 framework matrix rows pass** throughput ≥95%, TTFT ≤110%, spread ≤10% against the frozen vLLM `e9f169d1…` baseline; MTP4 service constraints, lifecycle, and long prefix reuse pass (`docs/handoff.md`, `docs/acceptance.md` as referenced).
- **Remaining work (explicit list in `docs/handoff.md`):** (1) re-verify the updated-documentation readback with MTP4 — the last real oh-my-pi runs had final answers that confused historical/current milestone counts (a Responses answer also misstated prefill scheduling order); (2) switch the default kernel backend from TileLang to CUDA and make runtime identity report the selected backend, keeping `OH_MY_VLLM_KERNEL_BACKEND=tilelang` as a comparison; (3) final checks, independent review, commit/push on `main`; (4) stop all task-owned GPU processes. No GPU services are currently running and port 18030 is released.

So: the framework is functionally complete and performance-accepted on the old default; the open item is the CUDA backend default cutover plus the final readback/review closeout.

**Citations:** `README.md`, `docs/requirements.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/handoff.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs`, `python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py`, with `docs/acceptance.md`, `docs/serving.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `docs/development.md`, and ADR-006/007 as referenced by those files.

# oh-my-vllm — Project Overview

## 1. Project Goals

A **Rust-first inference framework for Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on a single B200 GPU**, built so Rust owns serving, scheduling and the logical KV cache while Python owns GPU execution. The vLLM dependency is fully removed (independent runtime); the performance target is **≥95% of vLLM EngineCore throughput and TTFT ≤110%** across all 12 benchmark rows (ordinary/MTP4/prefix-hit at in=32768, batch 1/2/4, plus ordinary-only in=131072, out=4096) — see `README.md`, `docs/requirements.md` (REQ-GOAL-001, REQ-PERF-001/002).

Hard constraints from `docs/requirements.md` and `AGENTS.md`:

- **Model:** `/data0/shared/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8` — 48 GatedDeltaNet (GDN/Mamba) layers + 16 full-attention layers; **block size 784 tokens** (hybrid-architecture requirement, immutable).
- **Max context:** 262144 total tokens; boundary runs of 258048 in + 4096 out at batch 1/2/4 without OOM or recompute preemption (REQ-CONTEXT-001).
- **Features:** chunked prefill (32768-token budget), continuous batching, chain-hash prefix cache, recompute preemption, MTP4 speculative decoding, OpenAI-compatible Chat/Responses serving with thinking levels, tool calls, JSON/schema-constrained decoding (REQ-FUNC-*, REQ-SERVE-*).
- **Explicitly out of scope:** multimodal, multi-GPU, LoRA, swap preemption, production deployment (REQ-OUT-SCOPE-001).
- **Kernels:** all project-owned kernels migrated Triton → TileLang (REQ-KERNEL-001, accepted), now in the middle of a user-approved TileLang → **CUDA C++/PTX migration** (REQ-KERNEL-002), with the frozen TileLang backend kept as the comparison reference.

## 2. Architecture

Full description in `docs/architecture.md`; wire protocol in `docs/design.md`.

**Process split (REQ-ARCH-001):** a single ZMQ DEALER socket carrying msgpack; no shared memory, no tensors crossing the boundary, no vLLM runtime/scheduler.

**Rust side** (3 crates, workspace under `crates/`):
- `crates/scheduler` — FCFS waiting/running queues, per-step token budget, chunked prefill via `aligned_prefill` block-boundary alignment, continuous batching (running requests scheduled before new prefills), preemption by recompute (last-running evicted to waiting with `num_computed_tokens=0`), MTP draft accounting and rollback. This is a port of vLLM's V1 scheduler core, focused on Qwen3.8 single-GPU (`crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs` header; `schedule()` implements phase-1 running-queue → phase-2 waiting-queue with `HybridCoordinator` allocation).
- `crates/kv-cache` — hybrid logical block pool (FA group + Mamba group), SHA-256-truncated-to-64-bit chain-hash prefix cache with LRU eviction, aligned Mamba checkpoints at 784-token boundaries, speculative reservations; two-phase allocation (reuse prefixes before new pages).
- `crates/zmq-worker` — CLI, Axum-based OpenAI Chat Completions + Responses HTTP APIs, Python model-process lifecycle, cancellation, ZMQ transport, correlated UTC logging.

**Python side** (`python/oh_my_vllm/`):
- `worker/model_runner.py` — the concrete `OhMyVllmWorker`: loads the `Qwen` model (direct safetensors loading), allocates per-layer cache tensors at Rust-reported logical capacity, registers request state (`RequestSampler`), executes `SchedulerOutput` → validates history/state addresses, runs the model, samples with per-draft grammar masks, commits retained outputs and MTP proposals; independent cache groups (FA capacity vs `--mamba-blocks` GDN capacity) per ADR-007.
- `worker/batch_plan.py` (host validation, checkpoint copies), `worker/mtp.py` (shifted MTP cache, +1 RoPE shift, proposal graph), `worker/decode_graph.py` (CUDA graphs, ≤32 shapes per family), `worker/sampler.py`, `worker/serving.py` (tokenizer/chat template/XGrammar constraints, streaming, stored Responses), `models/qwen.py` (64-layer target + 1-layer MTP head).
- `kernels/` — project-owned TileLang kernels (GDN recurrence, causal conv, paged split-KV GQA decode, RMS/RoPE, fusions) with the frozen reference in `kernels/tilelang_reference`; the staged CUDA backend (`OH_MY_VLLM_KERNEL_BACKEND=cuda`) replaces them with B200 CUDA/inline PTX, no silent fallback.

**MTP details** (`docs/architecture.md`): greedy proposals verified against the target distribution (first mismatch/bonus sample terminates), recurrent BF16 SSM to retain block 784, rejected candidates never become cached prefixes, boundary snapshots preserved at every 784 crossing.

## 3. How to Run

Commands from `README.md` and `docs/development.md` (environment: conda `oh-my-vllm`, wrappers `scripts/with-env.sh` and idle-GPU-pinning `scripts/with-gpu.sh`):

```bash
# install (uv into the pinned env; no pip in env, no vLLM)
uv pip install --python /data0/shared/dongwu.chen/conda-envs/oh-my-vllm/bin/python -r requirements/runtime.txt

# build the Rust worker binary
scripts/with-env.sh cargo build --release --bin oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker

# offline text smoke test (GPU, MTP optional)
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python scripts/smoke-text.py \
  --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-text.ipc --max-tokens 64

# OpenAI-compatible local service (Chat + Responses at 127.0.0.1:8000/v1)
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh target/release/oh-my-vllm-zmq-worker \
  --socket /tmp/oh-my-vllm-serve.ipc --num-gpu-blocks 4200 --mamba-blocks 128 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --num-speculative-tokens 4 serve

# checks
scripts/with-env.sh cargo test --workspace   # + fmt --all --check, clippy -D warnings
scripts/with-env.sh ruff format python/ && scripts/with-env.sh ruff check python/
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' scripts/with-env.sh python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'

# performance matrix
scripts/with-gpu.sh scripts/with-env.sh python benchmarks/compare_vllm.py --mode ordinary --batch-sizes 1 2 4
```

Verification gates (2 warmups, ≥5 measured repetitions, spread/median ≤10%): `benchmarks/ttft.py` (independent TTFT/throughput gates), `benchmarks/baseline/enginecore.py` (isolated reference collector, run only in the separately maintained vLLM env — never in oh-my-vllm), `tests/probe_worker.py` (actual-model FP64 diagnostics, never for throughput).

## 4. Current Completion Status

Per `docs/handoff.md` (2026-09-22, authoritative current state) and `README.md`:

**Passed (current):**
- **CUDA kernel migration (REQ-KERNEL-002):** all **147 statically derived operator configurations** pass against the frozen TileLang reference — three independent rounds of 20 alternating-order paired timings each, plus a positive one-sided 95% paired-bootstrap gain bound per case. (The older 173-case inventory predates full-attention preparation fusion and is no longer active.)
- **Full CUDA correctness:** 173 tests + 28 subtests pass with no relaxed tolerances; actual-model ordinary/MTP4 eager FP64 probes pass; real-text isolation, prefix reuse, and forced-recompute preemption pass.
- **Max context:** six 258048-in/4096-out ordinary/MTP batch 1/2/4 boundary runs finish with exact output counts, zero OOM/preemption.
- **Performance:** all **12 framework rows** pass throughput ≥95% and TTFT ≤110% of the frozen vLLM main baseline (`e9f169d1…`, refreshed per user authorization on 2026-09-22), with spread/median ≤10%. No vLLM runtime/source dependency in the project.
- **Serving (REQ-SERVE-*):** Chat/Responses, thinking levels, tools, strict-JSON constrained decoding with MTP, Responses storage lifecycle, long prefix reuse all pass; both oh-my-pi agentic workflows verified real tool calls, follow-ups and accepted drafts.
- All Rust fmt/line-width/clippy/tests and Ruff checks pass; no task-owned GPU processes remain running.

**Remaining work (open):**
1. Verify the updated-document Chat/Responses agentic readback (current issue: final answers confuse historical vs current milestone counts, and the Responses answer wrongly claims prefill sorts last — `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs` actually schedules running/prefill before waiting; REQ-SERVE-003 acceptance criterion is exactly this task).
2. Switch the default kernel backend from TileLang to CUDA and make runtime identity report the selected backend; keep explicit `OH_MY_VLLM_KERNEL_BACKEND=tilelang` comparison.
3. Final relevant checks, independent review, commit and push on `main`; verify all GPU/port resources released.

**Not yet complete, by design:** swap preemption, multi-GPU, other model architectures/backends — documented extension points only (ADR-006, REQ-OUT-SCOPE-001), not implemented.

**Key files:** `README.md` (entry + layout), `docs/requirements.md` (confirmed acceptance criteria), `docs/architecture.md` (module map, MTP/cache/kernel design), `docs/handoff.md` (current status/remaining work), `docs/acceptance.md` (evidence), `crates/scheduler/src/lib.rs` + `python/oh_my_vllm/worker/model_runner.py` (the Rust/Python boundary implementation), `docs/cuda-development.md` (CUDA migration details).
